newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN LOSE OPENING GAME TO KAISERSLAUTERN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN LOSE OPENING GAME TO KAISERSLAUTERN.

text.p: German league champions Bayern Munich suffered a shock defeat to newly-promoted Kaiserslautern in their first game of the new soccer season in front of a sell-out home crowd on Saturday.
An 80th minute goal by the Dane Michael Schjonberg was enough to secure a 1-0 victory for Kaiserslautern, back in the top league after a one-year absence.
Bayern were without key players including Ghanian international Sammy Kuffour and striker Alexander Zickler.
Wolfsburg, promoted with Kaiserslautern last season, also won their first game, beating last year's relegation battlers Rostock with a last minute goal by Roy Praeger.
